Kitchens in Gloucester

We rip out and fit kitchens across Gloucester and Gloucestershire. Your kitchen is designed by the supplier and fitted by us, and a kitchen rip out usually takes 1 to 3 weeks depending on what's being done.

Call 07592 487841 WhatsApp Us

How We Do It

Kitchens are designed by the supplier and fitted by us to a very high standard.

How Long It Takes

  • A kitchen rip out and fit: usually 1 to 3 weeks, depending on what is being done

Shaker Kitchens and a Vaulted Kitchen

Our photos show a vaulted kitchen with a range cooker under an oak mantel and roof windows, painted shaker kitchens with under cabinet lights, and a kitchen part way through fitting with the tall oven housing in and the floor still covered.

Fitted Around the Room

The fitted kitchens run in an L or U shape round the walls, with double ovens set in a tall housing and the worktops lit from underneath. In the vaulted one the range sits under its own oak mantel, with roof windows letting light in over the sink.
